canonical_definition: A multimodal, multilingual, and multi-task benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on visual web understanding and code generation, covering website VQA, mockup-to-code, and code editing in four languages.

relationships.paper: WebMMU: A Benchmark for Multimodal Multilingual Website Understanding and Code Generation
relationships.evidence: We present WebMMU, a multilingual benchmark that evaluates three core web tasks: (1) website visual question answering, (2) code editing involving HTML/CSS/JavaScript, and (3) mockup-to-code generation.
